title: flake: Live E2E master-detail.spec.ts「Create with a task line」在 beforeEach 等页面标题超时，把 #38090 踢出合并队列
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) first queue eviction from this test (seat rule: file a flake card at the first eviction). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:build · Bug · p2 · reach: every merge-queue group runs Live E2E UI, so a red here evicts a PR whose diff cannot reach the page · evidence: one eviction, read by the #37894 card thread.
Dedupe: "master-detail.spec", "flake Live E2E" → 0 open. Closed sibling: #28471 (the same spec, a batch-request wait timeout; this one has a different shape).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：界面端到端测试里，「主从表单：新建项目并带一行任务」这一条偶尔在打开页面后 5 秒内等不到标题就超时，结果把一个跟界面无关的 PR（#38090）踢出了合并队列。
- 修法：查清这一条为什么偶尔等不到页面，修掉不稳的根因，不靠加长等待时间。
- 要你做的：无。

## Measured

- Queue commit 4696e22734 (main 0e361201 + PR #38090, a group of one). The only red is Live E2E UI, job 140849556074: `ui/e2e/live/master-detail.spec.ts:103` "Create with a task line stores the child referencing the parent". It failed in `beforeEach` (l.65): no "New Project + Tasks" heading within 5 s of `page.goto`.
- The other four tests that share that `beforeEach` (l.68, l.78, l.199, l.215) passed. One of 23 tests was red.
- PR #38090 touches no `ui/` or showcase path. Live E2E is green on the PR head c68c625b, and on the previous queue group at the same base 0e361201 (run 46102923263).
- The failure screenshot and error context are in artifact 15246781857. They were not read here, because the proxy refuses the blob download.

## Ask

1. Read the artifact and find why the heading is missing in this one test: the page state left by the earlier tests, the data the test seeds, or a load race. Check whether #37929 (action locations, new on main) is involved.
2. Fix the cause and keep the 5 s wait. A repeat-run proof (e.g. 20 runs green) goes in the PR.

## Acceptance

- The test is stable under repeated runs, and no queue group is evicted by it.
